title: BOs with KRA-deficient KYC (CDSL, DP-wise)
purpose: CDSL's DP-wise list of BOs whose KYC is not validated by a KRA, put in the DP's billing folder each cycle, with CDSL's freeze date in the communiqué. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code or the BO ID.
linked: Matched with the DP's CDSL accounts (BO ID, then each holder's PAN) on Compliance → KYC trading gate (Demat accounts).
source: CDSL/OPS/DP/POLCY/2026/325 and the monthly KRA-validation series; CDSL/OPS/DP/POLCY/2026/234 and 2026/770. The columns are not published: read by header names.
